reason: A DeepSeek Harness web plugin providing a right-side panel for browsing session files, viewing conversation history, and inspecting git status and diffs; human review is warranted because its documented routes read the filesystem and run git without authentication or sandboxing.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供右侧开发者面板，用于浏览会话文件、查看对话历史以及检查 Git 状态和差异。
summaries.en: Adds a right-side developer panel to DeepSeek Harness for browsing session files, reviewing conversation history, and inspecting Git status and diffs.

capabilities: Reads files from the current session working directory
Displays conversation history in the web UI
Runs git status and reads diffs for the current directory
Adds browser and Node components to the DeepSeek Harness web profile
